submission.natural_language_explanation: Fires on the word that opens a noun or verb complement right after a scope/locative or predicate head: mainly the determiner after locative 'in' (' the', ' a', ' an'; French ' la'/' une' after 'dans'/'en'), e.g. 'in the United States', 'in the world', 'in the house' (about 0.4-1.0 x max), weaker after 'into'/'over'/'on' (about 0.3-0.5), and a rate/degree adverb or participle right after a copula or 'a' in a clause about change ('is rapidly', 'is increasingly', 'is quickly', 'a growing', 'an infinite', about 0.6-0.9). Predicted inactive (below 0.25 x max, measured 16 of 20 plain sentences plus all 'at the' edits): English sentences of at most 12 tokens with no copula (is/are/was) and whose determiners follow only a verb or 'at', 'to', 'with', 'under', 'of', 'for' (e.g. 'We ate dinner at the restaurant.', 'He read the letter twice.', where only the final period reaches about 0.18), and code or number lists (about 0); outside that class are 'in/into/over/on/dans + determiner' and 'copula + adverb or adjective'.

له 7.3 ریشتری کرمانشاه باشد.
زلزله ای به قدرت 4.4 ریشتر تازه آباد در کرمانشاه را لرزاند
ایسنا نوشت:مسئول شبکه لرزهنگاری استان کرمانشاه با بیان اینکه تعداد پس لرزههای زلزله 7.3 ریشتری کرمانشاه به 1498 مورد رسیده است، گفت: در مجموع در 9 ماهه امسال نیز 1606 زلزله در گستره استان داشتیم.
معاون سیاسی و امنیتی استانداری کرمانشاه گفت: زلزله اخیر یک تهدید جدی بود که باید همه تلاش کنیم که به فرصتی برای توسعه کرمانشاه تبدیل شود.
پنجمین جشنواره منطقهای تئاترمعلولین زاگرس در استان کرمانشاه با مشارکت بهزیستی استان کرمانشاه و معاونت امور توانبخشی و همکاری بهزیستی استانهای همدان، لرستان، ایلام و کردستان طی ۱ تا ۴ دی ماه امسال در حال برگزاری است.
زلزله ای به قدرت 4.5 ریشتر سر پل ذهاب را لرزاند.
معاون سیاسی و امنیتی استانداری کرمانشاه گفت: باید سند فعالیت زنان در تمام حوزه های سیاسی، اجتماعی و اقتصادی براساس اسناد بالادستی و برنامه ششم توسعه تدوین شود.
ایسنا نوشت: مسئول جمعیت امداد دانشجویی-مردمی امام علی (ع) کرمانشاه از برگزاری جشن "شب یلدا" ویژه کودکان مناطق زلزله زده در مجموعه ورزشی "کوثر" سرپل ذهاب خبر داد.
زمین لرزه نسبتا شدیدی دقایقی پیش مرز عراق با استان کرمانشاه و استان کردستان را لرزاند
مهر نوشت: مدیرکل پزشکی قانونی استان کرمانشاه، آخرین آمار تلفات زلزله استان کرمانشاه را ۶۲۰ نفر اعلام کرد و گفت: ۴۱ نفر به آمار قبلی اضافه شده است.

How Do We Come In Contact With Mold?
Mold can’t survive without food. They thrive on moisture and organic matter. If an environment meets all growth requirements, mold releases spores and volatile organic compounds into the air which once inhaled makes the individual fall sick. Mold spores can find their way into the human body through the skin or when breathed in. in the same vein, food is not exempted. You can also get exposed to mold through rotten food.

While mold spores come into the home through air, others may be attached to your cloth, bags, or even pet’s fur. Your air conditioning unit can also bring in mold.
There are different types of indoor mold, amongst which black mold is considered one of the deadliest. Black mold, when breathed in, causes a wide range of health issues. Common areas to find mold in the home include bathroom, kitchen, damp cabinets, basement, potted plants, washing machines, air conditioning unit, drywall, and many more. You should also be mindful of personal items such as sponges, lunchboxes, and more.
Where can you find mold in the outdoors? Here are some of the surfaces where you risk exposure to mold – beaches, backyards, sidewalks, playgrounds, and forests. You’ll find mold in damp woods, piles of wet leaves, and rotted tree back.
Mold can also be found on food such as bread, nuts, and cereal. These molds release harmful toxins known as mycotoxins. Ingesting food infested with mold can cause serious health complications such as weakened immune systems, acute poisoning, cancer, and in extreme cases death.
Risks Associated with Exposure to Mold
Prolonged mold exposure isn’t advised. It can cause immune deficiencies which make you vulnerable to getting infected by just about any virus or bacteria. However, some people are more sensitive to mold than others. Those suffering from allergies might experience health complications when exposed to mold. Symptoms may include one or more of the following: cough, cold, fever, skin irritation, and difficulty in breathing.

The center is operated by the Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration, which is part of the US Department of Health and Human Services. The center's mandates include studying interventions and strategies for people who have an FASD, identifying communities with exemplary systems of care for FASD, providing technical assistance and Warning to improve services, and developing techniques for FASD prevention. To help achieve its mandates, the center has sought input from FASD constituency groups through its Steering Committee and a series of town hail meetings.

The purposes of the meetings were to identify needs and sham information about services that prevent and treat FASD. The meetings also were intended to raise awareness, facilitate coordination among service systems, and increase sup port for services at the state level. To organize the town hall meetings, the center worked with the FAS Family Resource Institute, the Alaska Office of FAS, and the National Organization on Fetal Alcohol Syndrome. These advocacy organizations were well positioned to recruit participants through established networks of concerned families, professionals, and organizations, and through traditional social marketing efforts.

A great amount of accidents take place in the work area due to carelessness and inconsideration. The work area should be keep clean and material and tools should be station in a safe and adequate place. Thus maintaining a protective attitude and practice would reduce and possibly eliminate slips,trips.and falls. In addition to the above mention facts ,it is reasonable that some type of barricades should be place at the opening of walls. Lastly working on roofs also require the same amount or even greater amount of caution and safety procedures should be followed to ensure one safety along with the safety of others.
Safe Practices – Working Areas and Surfaces
Working Areas and Surfaces
Slips, trips, and falls on walking and working surface cause 15 percent of all accidental deaths in the construction industry.
Such accidents can be avoided if workers are aware of their surroundings and follow the rules on the site.
It is your responsibility to keep all walking and working surfaces clean and dry.
Floors can be hazard in a number of ways.
• Ice, grease, oil, or wet processes can make them slippery.
• Tools, equipment, materials, or litter can clutter them.
• Unguarded opening in the floor or ground can cause fatal falls.
Wall openings are dangerous when they are not protected by guardrails or fences.
Platforms are work areas elevated above the floor or ground. These platforms, called open-sided platforms, are hazardous because they do not protect workers from falling over the edge.
To help prevent accidents, make sure platforms are dry and clear of materials and debris before stepping onto them.
Ramp and Runways:
The hazards of ramps and runways are similar to those of floors. Workers can trip on tools and equipment or slip on wet or icy surface.
There are some general guidelines that will help to avoid slips, trips, and falls on ramps and runway. Click on each number to know more:
1. Make sure the ramp is clear of tools, equipment, materials, or debris.
2. Check the surface before using it. If the ramp or runway is icy or wet, don’t use it until it is dry and free of ice. If ice cannot be removed wear shoes with skid-resistant cleats.
3. Make sure any tools or equipment you are carrying are turned off and secured. This will help prevent injuries if you fall.
The greatest hazard of using a ladder is falling. The following safe practices can help prevent slips and falls from ladders:
• Use appropriate fall protection.
• Wear safe, strong work boots that are in good condition.
• Watch where you step. Be sure your footing is secure.
• Maintain clean, smooth walking and working surfaces. Fill holes, ruts, and cracks.
• When climbing ladders, always face the ladder and use both hands.
• Clean up slippery material.
• Pick up any litter around a ladder.
• If you must climb to reach something, use a ladder that has been safely set up and properly secured at the top and the bottom.
